purpose: Materialize a current-dataset recurrence/history consumer from canonical banner definitions and occurrences without predicting cadence, first-ever release, duration, or future dates.

historyStatus.SINGLE_OBSERVED_OCCURRENCE: Exactly one canonical occurrence is observed for the definition in the current dataset.
historyStatus.REPEATED_OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES: Two or more canonical occurrences are observed for the same canonical definition in the current dataset.

definitionHistoryRules.firstObservedMeaning: Earliest canonical occurrence inside the current dataset only; never first-ever release unless separately proven.
definitionHistoryRules.latestObservedMeaning: Latest canonical occurrence inside the current dataset only.

occurrenceHistoryRules.appearanceIndex: 1-based chronological index inside one bannerDefinition history.
occurrenceHistoryRules.previousAndNext: Adjacency is defined only inside the same canonical bannerDefinition history.
occurrenceHistoryRules.gapDays: Calendar-day difference between adjacent explicit krDisplayDate values; it is an observed interval, not a cadence rule.
occurrenceHistoryRules.lifecycleBoundary: Stage 2-4 lifecycle remains separate and is not rewritten or inferred from history position.

prohibitedInferences: cross-definition recurrence from name, heroes, text, asset, bannerCode, patchCode, or slotCode

requiredFixtures.note: Corrected 7001 source identity must retain one shared history.

completionCriteria: 94 occurrence history entries represented exactly once
canonical IDs and occurrence-to-definition mapping unchanged
all adjacent pointers and gapDays recompute exactly from explicit dates
11 repeated definitions and 17 observed recurrence links for the current frozen population
no prohibited forecast or first-ever fields are materialized

nextStartPoint.task: Run whole-stage regression, consolidate Stage 2 production outputs, and freeze Banner Stage 2.
